criteria.requirement: find_referenced_templates yields base.html and an unknown dynamic reference represented by None. This is not proof of no dependency or the actual selected section.

Separate conservative possible dependencies from actual per-render dependencies; offer explicit application dependency registration or a credible existing-API instrumentation plan. Cover cached loads, fallback, deduplication and concurrent render isolation. A loader.get_source hook alone misses cache hits; do not invent a built-in Jinja collector.

comparison: Evaluate supported behavior, constraints and delivered evidence, not keywords, verbosity or reference-answer similarity.
